jobs.text: Plassey was a small battle, but its results were huge. The Company placed Mir Jafar on the throne as a puppet Nawab, and in 1765, after a further war, the Mughal emperor granted it the diwani, the right to collect taxes in Bengal, Bihar and Orissa. A trading company had become the ruler of one of the richest regions in the world.
